I have completed all the tasks outlined in the plan:

### 1. Placeholder & Asterisk Enhancements
* **Customer Details Input Fields**: The Customer Mobile and Customer Name inputs in [App.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/pos-app/src/App.jsx) now dynamically display an asterisk (`*`) when the POS user is under the **PreOrder** tray tab and pre-order details are set to mandatory in the backoffice settings.

### 2. Printer Copy Preferences & Double Print
* **Receipt Copy Preferences**: Added checkboxes under the **Printers** tab in the POS settings panel:
  * **Print customer copy for prebooking order**
  * **Print restaurant copy for prebooking order**
* **Printing Dispatch Logic**: Updated `handlePrint` in [App.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/pos-app/src/App.jsx) to check these settings when printing a prebooking order. If both are enabled, the app prints two separate copies labeled `(CUSTOMER COPY)` and `(RESTAURANT COPY)`.

### 3. Deployments & Local Building
* **Backoffice Changes Deployment**: The backoffice dashboard updates have been built and deployed successfully to Oracle Cloud.
* **POS App Build**: You can now proceed to package the updated POS application by running the build command in the `pos-app` folder:
  ```powershell
  npm run electron:build
  ```

Please refer to the updated [walkthrough.md](file:///C:/Users/Sajad/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/f6290d96-6827-4397-8034-a378a3d29f80/walkthrough.md) for how to perform manual checks. Let me know if you would like me to help with anything else!
